author: Jonathan
description_zh:
没有怪物，但要真实地活下去：吃饱、喝足、保暖，撑过 3 天！答题赚「知识点」，买装备、学知识，让你活得更轻松。

【详细玩法】
游戏目标：活3天
游戏开始：开始时，可以带5样东西
游戏操作：鼠标转视角 · WASD 移动 · E 砍树/采集/钓鱼/喝水 · F 吃东西 · G 喝水 · C 合成建造 · B 营地商店 · Q 答题赚知识点 · T 扎营(需帐篷)
description_en:
No monsters, just survive realistically: eat well, drink enough, stay warm, and survive for 3 days! Answer questions to earn 'Knowledge Points', buy equipment, and learn to make survival easier.

[Detailed Gameplay]
Goal: Survive for 3 days
Start: You can bring 5 items at the beginning
Controls: Mouse to look around · WASD to move · E to chop/gather/fish/drink · F to eat · G to drink · C to craft/build · B for Camp Shop · Q to answer questions for Knowledge Points · T to camp (requires tent)
